pr_summary: Consolidate containerd image metadata events to avoid duplicates in the workloadmeta collector. The fix modifies files in comp/core/workloadmeta/collectors/internal/containerd/ to handle image events properly and prevent duplicate metadata.
environment_management: Go modules (go.mod). Build orchestrated via invoke (Python-based task runner). Requires Python 3.9+, Go 1.21+, CMake 3.12+, C++ compiler.
platform_constraint_evidence: Primary Dockerfile at Dockerfiles/agent/Dockerfile uses Ubuntu base image
network_linux.go in containerd collector with '//go:build containerd' tag
Windows has separate unittests workflow (.github/workflows/windows-unittests.yml) indicating cross-platform support
pkg/util/system has platform-specific files: cpu_unix.go, cpu_windows.go, network_linux.go, network_windows.go
README.md build instructions reference Linux-focused setup with invoke
Containerd is primarily a Linux container runtime (though Windows support exists)
notes: This is a Go project (datadog-agent) using go modules for dependency management. The build system uses invoke (Python-based task runner). The project is cross-platform but primarily targets Linux. The containerd collector files use '//go:build containerd' build tags. Tests require the 'containerd' build tag. The fix involves consolidating image metadata events in the workloadmeta collector to avoid duplicates. Windows builds are supported but require separate tooling (MSYS2, Windows-specific scripts). The project requires Python 3.9+, Go 1.21+, CMake 3.12+, and a C++ compiler for development.
